summary: South kerb with a house 11 m back; cars park on the opposite side.

drivers.seclusion: A detached house sits 11 m behind the kerb, other homes 22 to 32 m away; street trees screen the frontage.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb lane next to a through road; no pull-off, but the road is wide.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the north kerb; none seen on this side.

flags: Steep: about 5% at the best section
sun_shade: Street trees shade the kerb from the south and morning side; open to afternoon sun.

best_section.where: south kerb of Harts Road, east end past the corner house
